bibl.title: Instrumental Analysis of the Inks from the Magical Papyrus P. Berol. inv. 5026 (PGM II / GEMF 30).
bibl.seg: O. Bonnerot, E. Chronopoulou & I. Rabin, Instrumental Analysis of the Inks from the Magical Papyrus P. Berol. inv. 5026 (PGM II / GEMF 30).
bibl.note: Introduction. - The papyrus P 5026 [= P.G.M. II, late second to early third century C.E.]. - Method. - Results and discussion. - Two ink-types, carbon and iron-gall, alternate through the main text.
